caption: Domain last-band occupancy contrast: D_between − D_within among the ten domain seeds of seed_bank_v1, per embedding space, with a 95% trajectory-bootstrap CI. Twin pairs are excluded from this figure. Physics/surreal are the reused S2.2 raw T=0.3 four.
alt_text: Domain last-band occupancy contrast: D_between − D_within among the ten domain seeds of seed_bank_v1, per embedding space, with a 95% trajectory-bootstrap CI. Twin pairs are excluded from this figure. Physics/surreal are the reused S2.2 raw T=0.3 four.
limitations: A gap whose CI excludes 0 means the seed still shapes the locked trajectory. It is not recovery of the prompt and not a semantic basin. Degenerate rows are kept: the lock is the sample.
